content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But we need the compound identity. Maybe the sample is implicit: the "sample at hand". We can get carbon NMR spectra which will list peaks, aromatic region ~120-150 ppm. Could count number of aromatic carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Let's call it.
